issues.summary: No explicit placement-rule config surface: signatureSemis()/tonicSemi() hard-coded the keysig.ly placement, leaving nothing for session 2's spec-mandated 'placement-rule controls' to edit
issues.resolution: Schema now carries keys.keySignature.placement = { rule, tonicOctave }: rule names the pitch-class-to-grid mapping ('scale-from-tonic', the D1 decision, is the only implemented value; validation rejects unknown rules; the renderer treats an unknown rule as inactive and renders nothing), and tonicOctave moved into placement since it is a placement parameter. Renderer reads placement.rule and placement.tonicOctave. Tests: defaults, validation (unknown rule, non-object placement, tonicOctave typing), and renderer behavior (unknown rule renders nothing; absent rule defaults). Documented as decision D8 in s1-notes.md, openly attributed to this round.

issues.summary: parseTonicPc was added to cnb/src/cnb-music.js, which is outside the session's declared Creates/Touches product files
issues.resolution: cnb/src/cnb-music.js and cnb/tests/cnb-music-tests.js restored byte-identical to the pre-session base commit (git checkout 9b033f9 --, verified by empty git diff against base). parseTonicPc now lives in cnb/src/cnb-key-signature.js (a session Creates file) as CNBKeySignature.parseTonicPc with the same behavior; its 4 tests moved into cnb-key-signature-tests.js. Module A's tonic-fallback warning was already parser-independent (structural /^\s*[A-Ga-g]/ complement) and is unchanged.

issues.summary: Preview/engine parity overstated ('reproduces keysig.ly by construction' / 'what the preview shows is what the engine engraves') while the submission itself documents divergences (dot style, tonicOctave)
issues.resolution: s1-engine-coordination.md section 2 rewritten: the correspondence is now stated as a design-level layout correspondence, not an output-identity guarantee, with an explicit enumerated divergence list (dot style preview-only; placement.tonicOctave and non-C-tonic auto-anchoring preview-only vs the engine's middleCPosition anchoring; separator styling and pixel sizing preview-side), cross-linked to the engine-repo backlog items they generate.
